evals.prompt: A prior assessment used bit_scope's downstream-impact test to say an open Risk was fine to carry into planning; the user overrides that with 'i want all risk resolved before planning'. Record this as a feedback note.
evals.expected_output: A note that quotes the scope's Risk entry verbatim, names bit_scope's downstream-impact test as the mechanism that produced the prior verdict, and states the user's actual standard (all risk resolved before planning) — short, observational, no proposed fix.
expectations: Quotes the scope's Risk line verbatim, not a paraphrase
Names the specific upstream mechanism (bit_scope's downstream-impact / de-risk-before-planning test)
States the user's standard: all risk resolved before planning, regardless of downstream impact
Stays observational: no cause, no proposed fix, no lesson learned

evals.prompt: Implementing a bar, the agent had to decide whether a plugin-install fallback also needs to register the marketplace first — a decision this session's own plan didn't settle (no other skill's mechanism involved). Record this as a feedback note.
evals.expected_output: A note citing the bar, stating what the plan said vs. what the work required, without inventing an upstream-mechanism citation where none applies.
expectations: States plan-said vs. work-required using the bar's actual wording
Does not force-name an upstream skill mechanism when the correction is a plain in-session decision

evals.prompt: Implementing a bar, the agent wrote a new script instead of using the project's existing scripts/rename_batch.sh. Record this as a feedback note.
evals.expected_output: A concise note citing the bar and the tool-choice correction, without forcing mechanism-naming language.
expectations: Does not force-name an upstream skill mechanism when none is involved
